children: FreeCast, Inc. (

), a provider of streaming media technology and Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solutions, today announced the appointment of Amy M. Weiss, CPA, to its Board of Directors, where she will also serve as Chair of the Audit Committee.

Weiss brings more than 15 years of experience in public-company accounting, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) reporting, financial oversight, technical accounting, and Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) auditing standards. Her appointment adds significant financial reporting and regulatory experience to FreeCast's Board as the company continues expanding its commercial operations and public-market presence.

Weiss currently serves as Chief Accounting Officer and Principal Financial Officer of a publicly traded company, where she oversees SEC reporting, financial statement preparation, external audit coordination, and technical accounting matters. She previously served as Corporate Controller and SEC Reporting and Accounting Consultant for the company.

Earlier in her career, Weiss spent more than a decade with PCAOB-registered accounting firm Liggett & Webb, P.A., advancing through positions including Principal and Audit Manager. Her responsibilities included managing public-company audits, reviewing SEC filings, evaluating complex accounting transactions, and supervising audit engagement teams.
Her professional background also includes consulting for public and pre-public companies on SEC reporting, financial controls, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance.

"Amy brings exactly the depth of public-company financial expertise and governance experience that we believe is valuable to FreeCast at this stage of our growth," said William Mobley, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of FreeCast. "As we expand our commercial partnerships, deploy our technology across additional markets, and build recurring revenue opportunities, strong financial oversight and transparent reporting remain essential. Amy's hands-on experience with SEC reporting, PCAOB audits, and public-company financial operations will be an important addition to our Board and Audit Committee."
Weiss holds a Master of Accounting from Nova Southeastern University and a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University. She is an actively licensed Certified Public Accountant in Florida.
Strengthening Governance to Support Commercial Expansion

The appointment reflects FreeCast's continued focus on building the corporate governance and financial oversight capabilities appropriate for a Nasdaq-listed company pursuing long-term commercial growth.

FreeCast's PaaS business model enables telecommunications providers, mobile network operators, internet service providers, multifamily property operators, and major consumer brands to deliver branded streaming entertainment services to their existing customers.

As the company advances its commercial agreements and platform deployments, FreeCast believes experienced Board oversight of financial reporting, internal controls, audit processes, and regulatory compliance will be increasingly important to supporting its operations and long-term business objectives.

"Our objective is to build FreeCast into a scalable, enduring public company," Mobley added. "Strengthening our Board with experienced professionals who understand the financial and regulatory responsibilities of public companies is an important part of that commitment."
About FreeCast, Inc.
FreeCast, Inc. (

) is a streaming media technology company providing a comprehensive Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution that enables telecommunications providers, internet service providers, property operators, and consumer brands to offer customized, branded entertainment platforms. FreeCast's technology brings together free and subscription-based streaming content, unified content discovery, subscription management, advertising monetization, and integrated payment solutions across connected devices. For more information, visit www.freecast.com.
